**Standards: PASS. Spec: PASS.**

The v2 manifest hashes match all five payload files; v1→v2 changes are limited to the journal, lifecycle guide, and effects verifier. V2 requires an open, unmerged PR and adds negative controls for preexisting PRs, ref pins, grant boundaries, unknown attempts, budgets, and corrupt facts.

The guide correctly keeps preexisting PRs without a local claim blocked—no auto-adoption or lost-store recovery. The exclusive `submitted` claim consumes the exactly-one invocation budget before POST; no separate counter is added.

Evidence supports only this bounded scope: fake-`gh` process/SIGKILL controls and offline `providerPromptStarted: false`; no kernel network-exclusion claim. It does not establish real GitHub behavior or whole-#68/client recovery.
